Dax 3.9.10

  • Every screen on your Mac now reaches your iPhone and iPad. Swipe between them in Dax Companion 1.5; the one in view is live, and Settings draws them all as they’re arranged.
  • The pairing code works with any camera. Scan it with an iPhone that doesn’t have Dax Companion yet and it takes you to the App Store, then straight into pairing. There’s no countdown to wait out.
  • AI Video agents can start up to 128 clips an hour, as long as you have the credits. The count drops again as the hour moves on, instead of only going up.
  • An agent’s failed renders come off the AI Video board, and each tab keeps one board and one player.
  • Progress indicators stay up while their agent waits between turns.
  • Scheduled Claude runs start in an explicit permission mode, so they don’t stop on a prompt nobody is there to answer.
  • Sites behind Cloudflare’s check load in Dax’s browser again, and an agent’s browser closes once its Instagram video is saved.
  • Full screen on the phone says what it’s waiting on before the Mac’s video starts.
